title.zh: 卷382 列傳一百六十九 瑚松额 布彦泰 萨迎阿
title.en: Volume 382 Biographies 169: Hu Song E, Bu Yan Tai, Sa Ying A
title.raw: 卷382 列傳一百六十九 瑚松额 布彦泰 萨迎阿

sentences.zh: 瑚松額，巴岳忒氏，滿洲正黃旗人，西安駐防。

translations.literal: Hu Song'e, of the Bayuete clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, stationed at the Xi'an garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Song'e, of the Bayuete clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner on garrison duty at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，以前鋒從將軍恆瑞剿湖北教匪，後隸那彥成、德楞泰部下，積功擢協領。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, as a vanguard he followed General Hengrui to suppress the sect rebels in Hubei; later he served under Nayancheng and Delengtai, and through accumulated merit was promoted to assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign he served as a vanguard under General Hengrui in the campaign against the Hubei sect rebels, then came under Nayancheng and Delengtai; his accumulated merit won him promotion to assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 十八年，滑縣教匪起，瑚松額率馬隊從副都統富僧德戰道口及滑縣城下，屢有功，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year [1813], when sect rebels rose in Huaxian, Hu Song'e led cavalry following Vice Commander Fu Sengde to fight at Daokou and below Huaxian city wall, repeatedly distinguishing himself, and was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Jiaqing, when sect rebels broke out in Huaxian, Hu Song'e led mounted troops with Vice Commander Fu Sengde at Daokou and beneath the walls of Huaxian, winning repeated credit and receiving a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢福州副都統，署福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year [1818], he was promoted to vice commander at Fuzhou and acted as Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was promoted to Fuzhou vice commander and served as acting Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，授察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang [1823], he was appointed commander of the Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Daoguang reign he was appointed Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year [1825], he was promoted to Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to general at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，西寧玉舒巴彥囊謙千戶分三百戶與其弟索諾木旺爾吉為小囊謙，由德爾格忒土司居間調處，辦事大臣斷定。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, the thousand-household of Nangqian at Xining Yushu Bayan divided three hundred households to his younger brother Sonam Wang'erji as the lesser Nangqian; the Dergetu native official mediated, and the resident minister ruled.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong, the Nangqian thousand-household of Yushu Bayan at Xining had allotted three hundred households to his younger brother Sonam Wang'erji as a separate lesser Nangqian; the Dergetu native chieftain mediated, and the resident minister gave a final ruling.

sentences.zh: 既而索諾木旺爾吉之子諾爾布不能服其屬戶，大囊謙欲兼併之，諾爾布訴於德爾格忒土司；

translations.literal: Later Sonam Wang'erji's son Norbu could not control his dependent households; the greater Nangqian wished to annex them, and Norbu appealed to the Dergetu native official;
translations.idiomatic: Later Norbu, son of Sonam Wang'erji, could not command his dependent households; the greater Nangqian sought to absorb them, and Norbu appealed to the Dergetu native chieftain;

sentences.zh: 大囊謙復以土司有欺凌小囊謙情事，互控不已，下瑚松額按之。

translations.literal: the greater Nangqian in turn charged that the native official had bullied the lesser Nangqian; they sued each other without end, and the case was sent down to Hu Song'e for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: the greater Nangqian then accused the native chieftain of oppressing the lesser Nangqian, and the mutual suits went on until Hu Song'e was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 奏請仍遵原斷，大囊謙不得覬覦屬戶，德爾格忒土司亦毋預鄰封事，以杜爭端，事乃定。

translations.literal: He memorialized that the original ruling should still be followed: the greater Nangqian must not covet dependent households, and the Dergetu native official must not interfere in neighboring jurisdictions, so as to stop disputes; the matter was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that the original decision should stand—the greater Nangqian must not encroach on dependent households, and the Dergetu chieftain must not meddle across borders—thus closing the dispute.

sentences.zh: 七年，署四川總督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year [1827], he acted as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served as acting governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九年，調吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year [1829], he was transferred to general at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to the Jilin generalship.

sentences.zh: 會宣宗東巡，扈蹕，校射，中三矢，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: When the Xuanzong Emperor toured the east, Hu Song'e escorted the imperial procession; at archery he hit three arrows, and was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xuanzong Emperor made his eastern tour, Hu Song'e joined the imperial escort; in the archery contest he scored three hits and received a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 十年，母憂回旗。

translations.literal: In the tenth year [1830], he returned to the banner on mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he left office to observe mourning for his mother and returned to the banner.

sentences.zh: 尋署盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Soon after he acted as general at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed acting general at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命偕尚書禧恩督師剿湖南瑤匪趙金龍，至則金龍已就戮，其黨趙青仔率餘匪竄廣東、湖北境，督兵剿平之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year [1832], he was ordered to join Minister Xi'en in commanding troops to suppress the Yao bandit Zhao Jinlong in Hunan; when they arrived Jinlong had already been executed, but his follower Zhao Qingzai led the remnant bandits into the Guangdong and Hubei borderlands, and Hu Song'e led troops to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was ordered with Minister Xi'en to command the suppression of the Hunan Yao rebel Zhao Jinlong; by the time they arrived Jinlong was already dead, but his lieutenant Zhao Qingzai had fled with the survivors into the Guangdong–Hubei borderlands, and Hu Song'e led troops to crush them.

sentences.zh: 廣東連山排瑤亦叛，率提督餘步雲等進剿，擒匪首鄧三、盤文理等，瑤眾投誠，全境肅清，賜雙眼花翎，予一等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: The Pai Yao of Lianshan in Guangdong also rebelled; he led Provincial Commander Yu Buxun and others in the campaign, captured the bandit leaders Deng San and Pan Wenli and others, the Yao submitted, the whole region was pacified, and he was awarded double peacock feathers and granted the hereditary rank of first-class light chariot commandant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Lianshan Pai Yao in Guangdong rose as well, he advanced with Provincial Commander Yu Buxun and others, captured the chiefs Deng San and Pan Wenli, received the Yao's surrender, and cleared the entire region; he was given double peacock feathers and the hereditary rank of first-class light chariot commandant.

sentences.zh: 命署福州將軍，台灣土匪張丙等作亂，授為欽差大臣，偕參讚哈哴阿赴剿。

translations.literal: He was ordered to act as Fuzhou general; when the Taiwan bandits Zhang Bing and others rebelled, he was appointed imperial commissioner and went with Adviser Ha'er'a to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to act as Fuzhou general; when Zhang Bing and other Taiwan bandits rebelled, he was made imperial commissioner and set out with Adviser Ha'er'a to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 及抵福建，提督馬濟勝已擒匪首，台灣略定。

translations.literal: When he reached Fujian, Provincial Commander Ma Jisheng had already captured the bandit leaders and Taiwan was largely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he reached Fujian, Provincial Commander Ma Jisheng had already taken the rebel leaders and Taiwan was largely quiet.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，命仍渡台搜捕餘黨，擒各路匪首二十餘人，賊黨三百餘人，分別置之法，械送張丙、陳辦、詹通、陳連至京誅之，加太子太保，復調成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year [1833], he was ordered to cross to Taiwan again to hunt down remnant factions, captured more than twenty bandit chiefs of various routes and over three hundred followers, punished them according to law, sent Zhang Bing, Chen Ban, Zhan Tong, and Chen Lian to the capital for execution, was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and was transferred back to Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirteenth year he was again ordered to Taiwan to root out surviving rebels; he seized more than twenty chiefs and over three hundred followers, dealt with them under the law, and sent Zhang Bing, Chen Ban, Zhan Tong, and Chen Lian to Beijing for execution; he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and returned to the Chengdu generalship.

sentences.zh: 十四年，瓘邊、馬邊夷匪勾結焚掠，提督楊芳擊斃夷目，以肅清入奏。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year [1834], Yi bandits on the Jian and Ma frontiers joined in burning and plundering; Provincial Commander Yang Fang killed Yi leaders and memorialized that the region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Yi bandits on the Jianbian and Mabian frontiers colluded in raids; Provincial Commander Yang Fang killed Yi chiefs and reported the area cleared.

sentences.zh: 既而夷复滋擾，瑚松額以芳辦理未善，劾罷之，自請議處，降一級留任。

translations.literal: The Yi soon harassed again; Hu Song'e held that Yang Fang's handling had been poor, impeached and dismissed him, asked that he himself be punished, and was demoted one rank but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yi soon stirred again, Hu Song'e judged Yang Fang's conduct inadequate, impeached and removed him, volunteered for disciplinary action himself, and was reduced one rank but kept in post.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year [1835], he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 疏陳兵丁驕縱，應加意訓練駕馭；

translations.literal: He memorialized that the soldiers were arrogant and insubordinate and should be trained and controlled with special care;
translations.idiomatic: He submitted that the troops had grown arrogant and lax and needed stricter training and discipline;

sentences.zh: 又密陳吏治情形，優詔嘉納。

translations.literal: he also privately reported on the state of official administration, and received an edict of warm praise.
translations.idiomatic: and also sent a confidential report on local governance, which the throne answered with warm approval.

sentences.zh: 十七年，京察，詔嘉其不露鋒鋩，細心任事，予議敘。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year [1837], at the capital inspection, an edict praised him for not showing off and for careful attention to duty, and he was marked for favorable consideration.
translations.idiomatic: At the seventeenth-year capital inspection an edict commended him for working carefully without ostentation, and he was noted for favorable treatment.

sentences.zh: 西藏堪布入貢，為四川番匪劫掠。

translations.literal: When a Tibetan khubilghan came to pay tribute, Sichuan fan bandits robbed him.
translations.idiomatic: A Tibetan khubilghan on tribute mission was robbed by Sichuan border bandits.

sentences.zh: 瑚松額捕賊數十人，得贓物；

translations.literal: Hu Song'e captured several dozen bandits and recovered the stolen goods;
translations.idiomatic: Hu Song'e seized several dozen bandits and recovered the plunder;

sentences.zh: 奏請貢道改由柴達木，由青海大臣遺兵護送。

translations.literal: he memorialized that the tribute route should be changed to pass through Qaidam, with troops from the Qinghai minister escorting it.
translations.idiomatic: he proposed rerouting tribute traffic through Qaidam under escort by the Qinghai resident minister's troops.

sentences.zh: 又以野馬川地連野番，請於大通河北岸立柵，山岩築設墩卡，派兵防守；

translations.literal: He also noted that Yema Chuan bordered wild fan territory and asked that barriers be set on the north bank of the Datong River, watch posts built on the cliffs, and troops assigned to guard them;
translations.idiomatic: Because Yema Chuan adjoined wild fan lands, he asked for stockades on the north bank of the Datong River, beacon posts on the heights, and garrison detachments;

sentences.zh: 提標前後二營廠馬合併，以厚兵力：並允行。

translations.literal: and that the front and rear battalion stud farms of the provincial command be merged to strengthen military forces: all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: and that the provincial command's two stud-farm battalions be combined to thicken the force—all of which was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，因病請開缺，尋致仕，許食全俸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year [1841], he asked to be relieved on account of illness, soon retired, and was permitted full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he sought release for illness, soon retired, and was allowed his full stipend.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，卒，贈太子太傅，賜卹，諡果毅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year [1847], he died; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, granted funeral honors, and given the posthumous title Guoyi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-seventh year and was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent with funeral honors and the posthumous title Guoyi.

sentences.zh: 布彥泰，顏扎氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Bu Yantai, of the Yanza clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Yantai, of the Yanza clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父珠爾杭阿，嘉慶初，官鑲黃旗滿洲副都統，以軍功予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: His father Zhuerhang'a, in the early Jiaqing reign, served as vice commander of the Bordered Yellow Manchu Banner and received the hereditary rank of cavalry commandant for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhuerhang'a, early in Jiaqing, held the vice commandership of the Bordered Yellow Manchu Banner and earned a hereditary cavalry commandant's rank for military service.

sentences.zh: 布彥泰由廕生授藍翎侍衛，襲世職，洊升二等侍衛。

translations.literal: Bu Yantai entered service through the yinsheng quota as a blue-lance bodyguard, inherited the hereditary office, and was gradually promoted to second-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Yantai entered through the hereditary quota as a blue-lance bodyguard, succeeded to the family rank, and rose step by step to second-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，充伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year [1818], he served as brigade commander at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was brigade commander at Ili.

sentences.zh: 道光初，擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daoguang, he was promoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Daoguang he was promoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 歷喀什噶爾參贊大臣、辦事大臣，伊犁領隊大臣，烏什辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He successively held the posts of Kashgar resident commissioner, resident minister, Ili brigade commander, and Ush resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Kashgar resident commissioner, frontier resident minister, Ili brigade commander, and Ush resident minister.

sentences.zh: 九年，授喀什噶爾總兵，病歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year [1829], he was appointed major-general at Kashgar and returned home on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made major-general at Kashgar, then went home ill.

sentences.zh: 十年，予副都統銜、乾清門行走，充哈密辦事大臣，調西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year [1830], he was given vice commander's rank and attendance within the Gate of Heavenly Purity, served as Hami resident minister, and was transferred to Xining resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he received vice commander's rank and duty within the Gate of Heavenly Purity, served as Hami resident minister, and was moved to Xining.

sentences.zh: 將軍玉麟薦其習邊事，調伊犁參贊大臣，再調塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: General Yulin recommended him as versed in frontier affairs; he was transferred to Ili resident commissioner, then again to Tarbagatai resident commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: General Yulin praised his knowledge of frontier affairs; he was shifted to Ili resident commissioner and then to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 十四年，復以病歸。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year [1834], he again returned home on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he again retired for illness.

sentences.zh: 十八年，署正藍旗漢軍副都統，擢察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year [1838], he acted as vice commander of the Plain Blue Chinese Banner and was promoted to Chahar commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he acted as vice commander of the Plain Blue Chinese Banner and was promoted Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 二十年，授伊犁將軍，入覲，命在御前行走。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year [1840], he was appointed Ili general; on entering audience he was ordered to attend before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was appointed Ili general; when he came to court he was ordered to attend in the imperial presence.

sentences.zh: 及赴任，授鑲黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: When he took up his post, he was appointed Mongol commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On taking up his post he was also made Mongol commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，疏陳開墾事宜，略言：「惠遠城三棵樹地方可墾地三萬餘畝，請就本地民戶承種輸糧。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year [1842], he memorialized on land reclamation, stating in brief: 'At the Three Trees near Huicheng more than thirty thousand mu can be reclaimed; local civilian households are requested to undertake cultivation and pay grain.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he memorialized on opening land, noting that more than thirty thousand mu near Huicheng's Three Trees could be farmed by local civilians paying grain tax.

sentences.zh: 阿勒卜斯地方可墾十七萬餘畝，請責成阿奇木伯克等籌計戶口，酌量勻撥。

translations.literal: 'At Alebs more than one hundred and seventy thousand mu can be reclaimed; the aqim beg and others are to calculate households and allocate shares as appropriate.'
translations.idiomatic: At Alebs, he wrote, more than one hundred seventy thousand mu could be opened, with the aqim beg and others to count households and apportion plots.

sentences.zh: 」至二十四年，疏報塔什圖畢等處開墾疊著成效，詔嘉其「忠誠為國，督率有方」，加太子太保。

translations.literal: By the twenty-fourth year [1844], he reported that reclamation at Tashitu'erbi and elsewhere had achieved successive results; an edict praised his 'loyal service to the state and effective supervision' and added Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: By the twenty-fourth year he reported steady gains at Tashitu'erbi and elsewhere; the throne praised his loyal supervision and made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 又命會勘烏魯木齊未墾之地，及各城曠地，一律興辦。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to survey unopened land at Urumqi and waste land at each garrison city and open it all.
translations.idiomatic: He was also told to survey unopened land around Urumqi and idle land at every garrison and bring it all under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 尋疏言：「惠遠城東阿齊烏蘇廢地，前任將軍松筠奏撥八旗餘丁耕種，因乏水，不久廢業。

translations.literal: Soon after he memorialized: 'The abandoned land at Aqiwusu east of Huicheng was memorialized by the former general Songyun for cultivation by surplus banner sons, but for lack of water it was soon abandoned.'
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported that the Aqiwusu tract east of Huicheng, which General Songyun had once assigned to surplus banner sons, had failed for lack of water.

sentences.zh: 今欲墾复，必逐漸開渠，極東且須引哈什河水，方可用之不竭。

translations.literal: 'To reopen it now, channels must be opened step by step; farthest east would even require drawing the Kash River before the supply would not fail.'
translations.idiomatic: To reopen it, he argued, canals would have to be dug in stages, and the easternmost section would need the Kash River before water would hold.

sentences.zh: 經營浩費，較前次各案不啻數倍。

translations.literal: 'The expense would be enormous, several times that of previous projects.'
translations.idiomatic: The cost, he said, would dwarf earlier schemes.

sentences.zh: 現委員勘估，又以伊犁歷屆捐墾成案，皆係收工而非收銀。

translations.literal: 'Commissioners are now surveying estimates; moreover, every prior donated-reclamation case at Ili collected finished work, not silver.'
translations.idiomatic: Surveyors were estimating costs; past Ili donation projects, he noted, had been reckoned in labor completed, not cash paid.

sentences.zh: 蓋辦工以工為主，計銀不如計工之直捷，亦不如計工之覈實。

translations.literal: 'For public works the work itself is the standard; counting labor is more direct and more verifiable than counting silver.'
translations.idiomatic: Public works should be measured by work done, he wrote—labor days were straighter and surer than silver tallies.

sentences.zh: 此次用夫匠五十三萬四千工，實墾得地三棵樹、紅柳灣三萬三千三百五十畝，阿勒卜斯十六萬一千餘畝。

translations.literal: 'This time 534,000 labor-days of craftsmen were used, and land actually opened amounted to 33,350 mu at Three Trees and Hongliu Bay and more than 161,000 mu at Alebs.'
translations.idiomatic: This round used 534,000 craftsman-days and opened 33,350 mu at Three Trees and Hongliu Bay and over 161,000 mu at Alebs.

sentences.zh: 荒地之開墾成田，由於渠工之開通水利，故不能劃出某頃某畝為某員所捐辦者，仍請免其造冊報銷。

translations.literal: 'Turning waste land into fields depends on opening irrigation works; therefore so many mu cannot be assigned to such-and-such an official as his donation; he still asks to be excused from compiling accounts for reimbursement.'
translations.idiomatic: Because fields followed canals, he could not tag each acre to a donor-official and again asked to be excused from reimbursement ledgers.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 時前兩廣總督林則徐在戍所，布彥泰於墾事一以諮之，阿齊烏蘇即由則徐捐辦。

translations.literal: At that time the former governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi Lin Zexu was in exile; Bu Yantai consulted him on all reclamation matters, and Aqiwusu was donated under Lin's name.
translations.idiomatic: Former governor-general Lin Zexu was then in exile; Bu Yantai consulted him on every reclamation matter, and Aqiwusu was credited as Lin's donation.

sentences.zh: 事既上聞，命布彥泰傳諭則徐赴南路阿克蘇、烏什、和闐週勘。

translations.literal: After the matter was reported, Bu Yantai was ordered to instruct Lin to go south to Aksu, Ush, and Khotan for a circuit inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Once the report reached court, Bu Yantai was told to send Lin on an inspection circuit through the southern prefectures of Aksu, Ush, and Khotan.

sentences.zh: 布彥泰疏留喀喇沙爾辦事大臣全慶暫緩更換，與則徐會勘。

translations.literal: Bu Yantai memorialized to retain Karashahr resident minister Quanqing temporarily without replacement, to join Lin in the survey.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Yantai asked to keep Karashahr minister Quanqing in place temporarily to survey with Lin.

sentences.zh: 凡歷兩年，得田六十餘萬畝。

translations.literal: Over two years they obtained more than six hundred thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: In two years they brought more than six hundred thousand mu under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 事俱全慶傳。

translations.literal: The full account was transmitted by Quanqing.
translations.idiomatic: Quanqing forwarded the complete report.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year [1845], he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 青海番匪連年肆擾，自二十三年總督富呢揚阿奏報進剿，驅回河南，實僅邀番僧賚撫，約不北犯。

translations.literal: Qinghai fan bandits had raided year after year; from the twenty-third year Governor-General Funiyang'a memorialized on the advance campaign, driving them back south of the Yellow River, but in fact he had only invited fan monks to negotiate and pledged they would not cross north.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai fan raiders had plagued the frontier for years; since the twenty-third year Governor-General Funiyang'a had reported driving them south of the Yellow River, but in truth he had only bought off fan monks with a promise not to cross north.

sentences.zh: 次年，复擾河北，掠涼州營馬匹，戕守備。

translations.literal: The next year they again raided north of the river, plundering horses of the Liangzhou garrison and killing an assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they crossed north again, looting Liangzhou garrison horses and killing an assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 富呢揚阿諉稱匪乃四川果克黑番，大雪封山難剿，而西寧鎮總兵慶和出口會哨，又遇賊被戕。

translations.literal: Funiyang'a evaded responsibility, claiming the bandits were Sichuan Guokehei fan and hard to suppress because heavy snow blocked the mountains; meanwhile Xining garrison commander Qinghe went out on joint patrol and was killed by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Funiyang'a claimed the raiders were Sichuan Guokehei fan whom snow-blocked passes made impossible to pursue, while Xining commander Qinghe, out on joint patrol, was slain by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 惠吉繼任總督。

translations.literal: Huiji succeeded as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Huiji took over as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 檄提督胡超進剿。

translations.literal: He ordered Provincial Commander Hu Chao to advance in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Provincial Commander Hu Chao to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 肅州兵不聽調，譁噪，胡超不能制。

translations.literal: The Suzhou troops would not obey orders and mutinied; Hu Chao could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou troops refused to march and mutinied; Hu Chao could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 惠吉籌辦未有緒，歿於任，乃以布彥泰代之，未至，命林則徐先署總督，並授達洪阿西寧辦事大臣，同治其事。

translations.literal: Huiji had not yet put plans in order when he died in office; Bu Yantai was appointed to replace him, but before he arrived Lin Zexu was first ordered to act as governor-general, and Da Hong'a was made Xining resident minister to handle the affair jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Before Huiji could organize the response he died in post; Bu Yantai was named to succeed him, but Lin Zexu was first ordered to act as governor-general, with Da Hong'a as Xining minister to manage the campaign jointly.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，布彥泰抵任，奏劾胡超畏葸，罷之；

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year [1846], when Bu Yantai took office, he memorialized impeaching Hu Chao for timidity and dismissed him;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Bu Yantai arrived and impeached Hu Chao for cowardice and removed him;

sentences.zh: 又論總兵站住攻剿不力，褫職遣戍。

translations.literal: he also judged the major-general Zhan Zhu for ineffective attack and stripped him of rank and sent him into exile.
translations.idiomatic: he also stripped Major-General Zhan Zhu for slack campaigning and sent him into exile.

sentences.zh: 達洪阿率兵剿平番莊，惟黑錯寺匪眾抗拒，攻下之。

translations.literal: Da Hong'a led troops to pacify the fan villages; only the Black Cuosi Monastery bandits resisted, and he stormed them.
translations.idiomatic: Da Hong'a swept the fan villages; only the Black Cuosi Monastery rebels held out, and he took them by assault.

sentences.zh: 又破果岔賊巢，拉布楞等寺僧收合四溝散番乞降，事乃定。

translations.literal: He also broke the Guocha bandit nest; monks of Labuleng and other monasteries gathered scattered fan of the four ravines and begged to surrender, and the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: He smashed the Guocha stronghold; Labuleng and other monasteries gathered scattered fan from the four ravines to sue for peace, and order was restored.

sentences.zh: 布彥泰以調度有方，被優敘。

translations.literal: Bu Yantai received favorable consideration for effective overall direction.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Yantai was marked for favorable treatment for sound overall direction.

sentences.zh: 親巡邊隘，疏陳西寧地勢因河為固，扼險設備，請於哈拉庫圖爾之南山根、南川營之青石坡，移建營堡，黃河北岸頭岱、東信、忙多各渡口設卡；

translations.literal: He personally toured the border passes and memorialized that Xining's terrain was secure because of the river, and that by holding choke points and setting defenses, camps and forts should be moved to the southern foot of Harakutur's mountain and the Qingshi Slope of the Nanchuan garrison, and checkpoints set at the Yellow River crossings of Toudai, Dongxin, and Mangduo on the north bank;
translations.idiomatic: Touring the passes himself, he argued that Xining's rivers made its ground firm, proposed relocating forts to Harakutur's southern foothills and the Nanchuan garrison's Qingshi Slope, and asked for checkpoints at north-bank crossings of Toudai, Dongxin, and Mangduo;

sentences.zh: 又奏复防河舊章，安置營汛：並如議行。

translations.literal: he also memorialized to restore the old regulations for river defense and redeploy garrison posts: all were approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: he also asked to restore former river-defense rules and garrison dispositions—all approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，安集延布魯特糾合回子圍喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾，詔布彥泰率兵赴肅州，授為定西將軍，奕山為參贊大臣，將大舉出師。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year [1847], Kokand and the Buruts joined with Muslims to besiege Kashgar and Yengisar; Bu Yantai was ordered to lead troops to Jiuquan, appointed Pacification General of the West, with Yishan as adviser, for a major expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Kokand and Burut allies with local Muslims besieged Kashgar and Yengisar; Bu Yantai was ordered to Jiuquan as Pacification General of the West, with Yishan as adviser, for a major campaign.

sentences.zh: 會奕山率邊兵戰捷，賊退，二城解圍，軍事告竣，布彥泰回任。

translations.literal: Yishan led frontier troops to victory, the rebels retreated, the two cities were relieved, military affairs concluded, and Bu Yantai returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Yishan's frontier force won, the enemy withdrew, both cities were saved, and Bu Yantai returned to his governorship.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，因病請罷，許之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year [1849], he asked to resign on account of illness and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he sought release for illness and was allowed to retire.

sentences.zh: 時為固原知州徐采饒等所訐，命協辦大學士祁俊藻往會總督琦善按之，坐關防不密、清查歧誤，及失察家人，議降調革任。

translations.literal: At that time he was impeached by Guyuan prefect Xu Cairao and others; Associate Grand Secretary Qi Junzao was sent to join Governor-General Qishan in investigation; he was found guilty of lax seal control, errors in audit, and failure to supervise his household, and was sentenced to demotion, dismissal, and forfeiture.
translations.idiomatic: He was then denounced by Guyuan prefect Xu Cairao and others; Associate Grand Secretary Qi Junzao joined Governor-General Qishan in an inquiry; lax seals, audit mistakes, and unchecked servants earned a sentence of demotion and dismissal.

sentences.zh: 尋予二等侍衛，充葉爾羌幫辦大臣，調伊犁參贊大臣，偕將軍奕山會議俄羅斯通商事宜，語詳奕山傳。

translations.literal: Soon after he was given second-class bodyguard and served as assistant minister at Yarkand, was transferred to Ili resident commissioner, and with General Yishan negotiated Russian trade matters, detailed in Yishan's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was restored as second-class bodyguard, made assistant minister at Yarkand, then Ili resident commissioner, and with General Yishan handled Russian trade—the details appear in Yishan's biography.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，授正白旗漢軍副都統，仍留邊任。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng [1852], he was appointed vice commander of the Plain White Chinese Banner while remaining on frontier duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he was made vice commander of the Plain White Chinese Banner but kept on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 四年，回京，命赴王慶坨軍營，以疾未行，請開缺。

translations.literal: In the fourth year [1854], he returned to the capital and was ordered to the Wangqingtuo army camp; illness prevented his going, and he asked to be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he returned to Beijing, was ordered to the Wangqingtuo camp, could not go for illness, and asked to be relieved.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，卒，年九十。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu [1880], he died at the age of ninety.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year of Guangxu, aged ninety.

sentences.zh: 詔念前勞，依都統例賜卹。

translations.literal: An edict recalled his earlier service and granted funeral honors according to the commander standard.
translations.idiomatic: The throne remembered his earlier service and granted commander-level funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 薩迎阿，字湘林，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sa Ying'a, style Xianglin, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Ying'a, courtesy name Xianglin, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十三年舉人，授兵部筆帖式。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jiaqing [1808] he passed the provincial examination and was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Jiaqing he passed the provincial examinations and entered the Ministry of War as a clerk.

sentences.zh: 擢禮部主事，洊升郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Rites and gradually rose to department director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to director in the Ministry of Rites and step by step to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，出為湖南永州知府，調長沙。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang [1823], he went out as prefect of Yongzhou in Hunan and was transferred to Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daoguang he left the capital as prefect of Yongzhou in Hunan, then was moved to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 歷山東兗沂曹道、甘肅蘭州道。

translations.literal: He served as intendant of Yan-Yi-Cao in Shandong and of Lanzhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He held the Yan-Yi-Cao circuit in Shandong and the Lanzhou circuit in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 七年，就遷按察使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year [1827], he was promoted in place to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted in place to surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以治回疆軍需，賜花翎。

translations.literal: For managing military supplies in the Muslim borderlands, he was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: For handling frontier military supplies he received a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢河南布政使，未任，予副都統銜，充哈密辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year [1826], he was promoted to Henan provincial treasurer, but before taking office was given vice commander's rank and appointed Hami resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted Henan treasurer, but before assuming the post received vice commander's rank and the Hami resident ministry.

sentences.zh: 調喀喇沙爾辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Karashahr resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was then moved to Karashahr resident minister.

sentences.zh: 十年，安集延擾喀什噶爾邊卡，薩迎阿赴土爾扈特、霍碩特召兵赴援，又襄治南路糧運。

translations.literal: In the tenth year [1830], when Kokand disturbed the Kashgar border post, Sa Ying'a went to the Torghut and Khoshut to summon troops for relief and also assisted in managing southern-route grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, when Kokand raided the Kashgar border, Sa Ying'a rallied Torghut and Khoshut troops and helped manage southern-route grain shipments.

sentences.zh: 授盛京工部侍郎，兼管奉天府尹事。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice minister of Works at Mukden and concurrently managed Mukden prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Mukden vice minister of Works and concurrently ran the prefectural administration.

sentences.zh: 十一年，留京署鑲白旗漢軍副都統，充烏什辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year [1831], he remained in the capital acting as vice commander of the Bordered White Chinese Banner and served as Ush resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he stayed in Beijing as acting vice commander of the Bordered White Chinese Banner and took the Ush resident ministry.

sentences.zh: 歷哈密辦事大臣、葉爾羌幫辦大臣，仍調哈密辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He successively held the posts of Hami resident minister, assistant minister at Yarkand, and again Hami resident minister.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Hami resident minister, assistant minister at Yarkand, and again Hami resident minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授盛京禮部侍郎，兼管府尹事，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year [1835], he was appointed vice minister of Rites at Mukden and concurrently managed prefectural affairs, then was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made Mukden vice minister of Rites with concurrent charge of the prefecture, then moved to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二十年，召授禮部侍郎，兼鑲紅旗漢軍副都統，調戶部，兼管錢法堂。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year [1840], he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Rites, concurrently vice commander of the Bordered Red Chinese Banner, transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, and concurrently managed the Bureau of Currency.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was recalled as vice minister of Rites, made concurrent vice commander of the Bordered Red Chinese Banner, shifted to Revenue, and took charge of the Bureau of Currency.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢熱河都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year [1843], he was promoted to Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was promoted commander at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，授伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year [1845], he was appointed Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed Ili general.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊興辦喀喇沙爾渠道堤壩，下薩迎阿籌議。

translations.literal: When Urumqi undertook Karashahr canal dikes and embankments, the matter was sent down to Sa Ying'a for planning.
translations.idiomatic: Urumqi's Karashahr canal works were referred to Sa Ying'a for planning.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「喀喇沙爾城西開都河，道光十七年，築護堤，有屯田頭工、二工兩渠，自裁屯安戶後，又於上游大河開一大渠，嗣頭二工又各添新渠，共有五渠。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'West of Karashahr city is the Kaidu River; in the seventeenth year of Daoguang protective dikes were built, with the first and second works of garrison fields and two canals; after cutting garrison households, a large canal was opened on the upper main river, and later the first and second works each added new canals, making five canals in all.'
translations.idiomatic: He reported that west of Karashahr lay the Kaidu River; in Daoguang seventeen protective dikes were built with two garrison-field canals; after household cuts a main upper canal was added, then new branches at the first and second works—five canals in all.

sentences.zh: 上年大水，各渠口沖塌，護堤亦壞。

translations.literal: Last year great floods washed out every canal mouth and destroyed the protective dikes as well.
translations.idiomatic: The previous year's flood had breached every intake and ruined the dikes.

sentences.zh: 今擬挑濬北大渠，接長二千三百丈，共長九千丈；

translations.literal: 'It is now proposed to dredge the northern great canal, extending it 2,300 zhang for a total length of 9,000 zhang;'
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dredging the northern main canal, adding 2,300 zhang to reach 9,000 zhang in all;

sentences.zh: 修築龍口石工，外設木閘，自龍口至坡心灘嘴，築碎石長壩四十餘丈，中設洩水閘，隨時啟閉；

translations.literal: 'to build stone works at the dragon mouth with outer wooden gates, from the dragon mouth to Poxin beach point to build a rubble long dam of more than forty zhang with a sluice gate in the middle for opening and closing as needed;'
translations.idiomatic: stone works at the dragon mouth with timber gates, a forty-zhang rubble dam from mouth to Poxin beach point, and a central sluice opened or shut as needed;

sentences.zh: 接長舊堤三十餘裡，至北大渠口為止；

translations.literal: 'to extend the old dike more than thirty li to the mouth of the northern great canal;'
translations.idiomatic: extension of the old dike thirty-odd li to the northern canal mouth;

sentences.zh: 其餘諸渠挑濬深通，庶期經久。

translations.literal: 'the remaining canals to be dredged deep and clear, so as to last.'
translations.idiomatic: and deep dredging of the other canals for lasting use.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「吐魯番掘井取泉，由地中連環導引，澆灌高田，以備渠水所不及，名曰閘井，舊有三十餘處。

translations.literal: 'He also stated: "At Turfan wells are dug for springs, led in linked channels underground to irrigate high fields where canal water cannot reach, called gate-wells; there were formerly more than thirty."'
translations.idiomatic: He also described Turfan gate-wells—underground chains of shafts watering high fields beyond canal reach—of which more than thirty had existed.

sentences.zh: 現因伊拉里克戶民無力，飭屬捐錢籌辦，可得六十餘處，共成百處。

translations.literal: 'Because Yilarik households are unable to bear the cost, subordinates are ordered to raise funds by donation, and more than sixty additional sites can be obtained, making one hundred in all.'
translations.idiomatic: With Yilarik households unable to pay, he ordered local officials to raise donations for sixty-odd new wells, bringing the total to one hundred.

sentences.zh: 」尋以開墾挑渠辦有成效，薩迎阿履勘，籌議招種昇科。

translations.literal: Soon, because opening land and dredging canals had achieved results, Sa Ying'a made an on-site inspection and planned recruitment of cultivators and graduated taxation.
translations.idiomatic: When reclamation and canal work showed results, Sa Ying'a inspected on site and planned settlement and graduated land tax.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「墾地在渠水充盈，用有餘裕，昇科不必求急，期實有裨益，行之久長。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'When reclaimed land has abundant canal water and surplus use, graduated taxation need not be rushed; it should truly benefit and last long.'
translations.idiomatic: He urged that where canals ran full, tax increases should wait until surplus was proven and durable benefit assured.

sentences.zh: 新疆水利，泉水少而雪水多，雪水之遲早無定，收穫之豐歉難齊，請援鎮、迪舊例，減半昇科。

translations.literal: 'In Xinjiang waterworks, spring water is scarce and snow water abundant; the timing of snow water is uncertain and harvests hard to equalize; he asked to follow the old precedents of Zhen and Di and apply half-rate graduated taxation.'
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang relied on uncertain snowmelt more than springs, he noted, so harvests would vary; he asked half-rate graduated tax as at Zhen and Di.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved and ordered implementation.

sentences.zh: 英吉沙爾領隊大臣齊清額誤聽伯克言，誣指回子胡完為張格爾逆裔，薩迎阿平反之，詔嘉其詳慎。

translations.literal: Yengisar brigade commander Qi Qing'e, misled by a beg's words, falsely charged the Muslim Hu Wan as a descendant of the rebel Jahangir; Sa Ying'a reversed the case, and an edict praised his thorough caution.
translations.idiomatic: Yengisar commander Qi Qing'e, trusting a beg, had called the Muslim Hu Wan a Jahangir heir; Sa Ying'a cleared him, and the throne praised his careful judgment.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，安集延布魯特回眾入卡，圍喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾二城，薩迎阿檄調諸城兵往剿，葉爾羌參贊大臣奕山率諸軍由巴爾楚克進，三戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year [1847], Kokand and Burut Muslims entered the border pass and besieged Kashgar and Yengisar; Sa Ying'a ordered troops from the garrison cities to suppress them; Yarkand resident commissioner Yishan led the armies forward from Barkul and won three battles in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Kokand and Burut Muslims crossed the pass and besieged Kashgar and Yengisar; Sa Ying'a mobilized the garrison cities while Yishan advanced from Barkul and won three straight victories.

sentences.zh: 薩迎阿別遣兵扼樹窩子，二城圍尋解。

translations.literal: Sa Ying'a separately sent troops to hold Shuwozi, and the sieges of the two cities were soon lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Ying'a also blocked Shuwozi with a detached force, and both sieges soon lifted.

sentences.zh: 時方命陝甘總督布彥泰督師，未出關而事平。

translations.literal: At that time Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Bu Yantai had just been ordered to command the army, but before he left the pass the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Yantai had just been ordered to take command, but the crisis ended before he crossed the frontier.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，召授正白旗滿洲都統，會陝甘總督琦善剿青海番匪，言官劾其妄殺，命薩迎阿赴西寧按之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng [1851], he was summoned and appointed Mongol commander of the Plain White Banner; joining Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Qishan in suppressing Qinghai fan bandits, censors impeached Qishan for indiscriminate killing, and Sa Ying'a was ordered to Xining to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he was made Plain White Mongol commander; when censors accused Qishan of slaughter in the Qinghai fan campaign, Sa Ying'a was sent to Xining to investigate.

sentences.zh: 奏調刑部司員梁照、奎椿、武汝清隨同鞫訊，得番子十四名無辜誣服狀，疏陳琦善剿辦黑城撒拉回子及黃喀窪番賊，尚非無故興師，惟將雍沙番族殺斃多名，實係妄加誅戮，並及文武妄拿、刑求逼供，詔褫琦善職，逮京訊治，命薩迎阿暫署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting Ministry of Justice clerks Liang Zhao, Kuichun, and Wu Ruqing to join the inquiry; fourteen fan were found to have confessed under false charges; he reported that Qishan's campaigns against Heicheng Salar Muslims and Huangkawa fan bandits were not wholly without cause, but that killing many of the Yongsha fan clan was truly indiscriminate slaughter, together with civil and military officials' wrongful arrests and torture to force confession; an edict stripped Qishan of office and summoned him to the capital for trial, and ordered Sa Ying'a to act temporarily as governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: With Ministry of Justice clerks Liang Zhao, Kuichun, and Wu Ruqing he found fourteen fan had confessed under duress; Qishan's strikes at Heicheng Salars and Huangkawa bandits were not wholly groundless, but the Yongsha killings and torture were real; Qishan was stripped and sent to Beijing for trial while Sa Ying'a acted as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甘肅營務廢弛，雖議整頓，而番匪時復出擾。

translations.literal: Gansu military affairs were lax; although reorganization was discussed, fan bandits again raided from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu defenses remained slack; fan raids continued despite talk of reform.

sentences.zh: 新授福建巡撫王懿德途經金縣，士民呈控，奏下薩迎阿察治，屢被詰責。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Fujian governor Wang Yide, passing through Jinxian, was petitioned by local scholars and commoners; the memorial was sent down to Sa Ying'a for investigation and he was repeatedly rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: When incoming Fujian governor Wang Yide passed Jinxian, locals petitioned; the case went to Sa Ying'a, who drew repeated reprimands.

sentences.zh: 二年，解任回京。

translations.literal: In the second year [1852], he was relieved and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was relieved and returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 自琦善之逮治也，刑部尚書恆春以薩迎阿論劾過當，欲令原訊司員對簿，獨侍郎曾國籓持不可。

translations.literal: From the time of Qishan's arrest, Minister of Justice Hengchun held that Sa Ying'a's impeachment had been excessive and wished the original examining clerks to confront him in court; only Vice Minister Zeng Guofan objected.
translations.idiomatic: After Qishan's arrest, Justice Minister Hengchun thought Sa Ying'a had overreached and wanted the original clerks to confront him; only Vice Minister Zeng Guofan dissented.

sentences.zh: 及廷臣會訊讞上，琦善遣戍吉林，司道以下文武論罪有差，被誣番子免罪，略如原讞。

translations.literal: When the court ministers jointly reported the verdict, Qishan was exiled to Jilin, civil and military officials from intendant down were punished in varying degrees, the falsely charged fan were acquitted, and the outcome largely followed the original finding.
translations.idiomatic: At the joint court review Qishan went to exile in Jilin, officials were punished by rank, the framed fan were freed, and the outcome largely matched Sa Ying'a's report.

sentences.zh: 薩迎阿坐未取應議各員供詞，遽行擬罪，又因子書紳與司員同坐問供，下部議，書紳降三級調用，薩迎阿降四級留任。

translations.literal: Sa Ying'a was found guilty of sentencing without first obtaining the statements of officials who should have been consulted, and also because his son Shuzhen sat with the clerks during interrogation; the ministry deliberated: Shuzhen was demoted three ranks and transferred, Sa Ying'a demoted four ranks but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Ying'a was faulted for sentencing before collecting required testimony and for letting his son Shuzhen sit with the clerks; Shuzhen was demoted three ranks, Sa Ying'a four but kept in post.

sentences.zh: 歷署鑲藍旗、正紅旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He successively acted as Mongol commander of the Bordered Blue and Plain Red Banners.
translations.idiomatic: He later acted as Mongol commander of the Bordered Blue and Plain Red Banners.

sentences.zh: 六年，出署西安將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year [1856], he went out to act as Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he went out to act as Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 逾歲卒，詔念回疆軍務曾著勞績，賜卹，諡恪僖。

translations.literal: A little more than a year later he died; an edict recalled his meritorious service on the Muslim borderlands, granted funeral honors, and gave the posthumous title Kexi.
translations.idiomatic: He died a little over a year later; the throne recalled his frontier service, granted funeral honors, and gave the posthumous title Kexi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：瑚松額川、陝舊將，屢任專徵，雖無赫赫功，尚持大體，晚膺疆寄，稱厥職焉。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Hu Song'e was an old general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, repeatedly entrusted with independent command; though he had no resounding achievements, he still upheld the larger pattern, and in his later frontier appointment fulfilled his duties.
translations.idiomatic: The historian notes: Hu Song'e, a veteran of Sichuan and Shaanxi campaigns, lacked dazzling victories yet held to proper form and, in his late frontier post, did his duty.

sentences.zh: 布彥泰新疆開墾，西寧平番，胥賴林則徐之擘畫。

translations.literal: Bu Yantai's Xinjiang reclamation and Xining pacification of the fan both relied on Lin Zexu's planning.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Yantai's Xinjiang reclamation and Xining fan pacification both depended on Lin Zexu's designs.

sentences.zh: 薩迎阿平反番獄，持正不阿，而治番亦無良策。

translations.literal: Sa Ying'a reversed the fan cases and held firm without compromise, yet he too had no good policy for governing the fan.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Ying'a righted the fan prosecutions with integrity, yet had no lasting policy for fan affairs.

sentences.zh: 蓋番族生計無資。

translations.literal: For the fan clans had no means of livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: The root trouble was that the fan lacked livelihood.

sentences.zh: 營伍廢弛已久，議剿議撫，補苴一時。

translations.literal: The garrisons had long been lax; debating suppression or appeasement only patched matters for a time.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisons had decayed for years; debate over fighting or soothing could only patch the moment.

sentences.zh: 林則徐謂治番自古無一勞永逸之計，亦慨乎其言之也。

translations.literal: Lin Zexu said that governing the fan had never had a once-for-all solution since antiquity — and one must sigh at the truth of his words.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zexu had said that since antiquity no policy toward the fan had ever been permanent — a verdict that still rings true.
